rules: A slot is a group. 149 club/unit/position slots publish more than one rank-1 player; the graph keeps them together instead of inventing a single starter.
A player on a reserve list is absent from the weekly report by construction. 'Not listed' never means 'available'.
Depth is measured from playing time (snap share), never from jersey number, experience or salary.
No .confirmed replacement. is published unless an official source names one. The backup shown is the club's own next published name, which is evidence of order, not of assignment.
limits: Two clubs publish no parseable depth chart; the graph is missing those clubs rather than guessing (Texans publish the chart as an image; Packers prepend jersey numbers — the decision-lab capture records both failures).
Snap counts are community-sourced; they are used to observe workload, never relabelled as official.
One injury-report observation exists. It cannot support a backtest; see the capture log.
